summary: Faraday Future Intelligent Electric Inc. filed an 8-K on August 31, 2026, reporting mutual termination agreements with holders of incremental warrants issued under a March 21, 2025 securities purchase agreement. The terminated warrants were exercisable for convertible promissory notes aggregating $21,021,369 principal, common stock purchase warrants, and Series B preferred shares. The company and warrant holders agreed to cancel these instruments, eliminating potential future conversion or exercise obligations. A press release was issued September 1, 2026. This is a liability management move reducing overhang; watch for further dilution reduction or capital restructuring signals.
